The cause

Every game helps bring a smile.

The Davao Smiles Dental Mission brings free dental care to kids who'd otherwise go without. Every donation this Thursday goes toward the mission — helping give more kids a healthy smile.

No pickleball experience needed — open play means all levels are welcome, games rotate through the evening, and every donation counts toward the mission.

3 hrs
of open play, rotating games for every skill level
100%
of donations go to the Davao Smiles Dental Mission
Before you come

What to know

Donations

Everyone's welcome. Donations support the Davao Smiles Dental Mission, with suggested amounts of ₱500, ₱1,000, or ₱2,000+.

Paddles

Bring your own if you have one. We'll have a few paddles to borrow, but the number is limited, so first come, first served.

What to wear

Comfortable athletic clothes and court or non-marking sport shoes, since we're playing indoors.

All levels welcome

First time holding a paddle? You're welcome. Games rotate through the evening so everyone gets to play. Walk-ins are fine, but an RSVP helps us plan courts.

Save your spot

RSVP for open play

Let us know you're coming so we can plan courts and rotations. Walk-ins are welcome too, but an RSVP helps us keep the evening running smoothly.
